name: Amanatides and Woo Voxel Traversal
aliases: Amanatides and Woo Voxel Ray Traversal
A Fast Voxel Traversal Algorithm for Ray Tracing
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for sparse voxel grids that steps through voxels along the ray's path by advancing to the nearest voxel boundary on the axis with the smallest t-value.
